title: 第9章 被雷劈活了第10章 想要和离
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田

;;
宣和帝拿着笔的手抖了抖，老脸也跟着抽了抽，眼前姑娘瞧着还是那般娇弱胆小，却不知为何后背发凉，浑身汗毛直竖。
“像什么话，赶紧起来。”宣和帝抽搐着嘴角说道。
“呜呜，皇伯父，鱼儿不起。”沈青鱼眼泪说掉就掉，眨眼功夫就泪流满面，瞧着好生可怜。
宣和帝一看，既心疼，那种不妙感又越发强烈。这孩子哭成这样，不会是要憋什么大招吧。
“老王快，快把她扶起来。”
老王忙上前去搀扶，沈青鱼顺势就起来了，忘了自己不过才开脉，身体比普通人强不了多少，刚那一跪把她给疼得眼泪哗哗的。
“受欺负了？”宣和帝问。
沈青鱼忙不迭点头，将昨日落水前后的事情简单说了下，不过没提云珏的事情。
宣和帝听完后笑了，道：“这事朕已经听人说了，不过你不是也没吃亏？柳家那姑娘可是被你踹断好几根肋骨，从昨日到现在，都抢救好几回了。”
沈青鱼差异：“我一个娇弱普通女子，有这么厉害的吗？”
老王刚听了个消息，闻言忍不住道：“是啊，刚传来消息，那柳姑娘今日还让雷给劈了。不过说来也奇怪，这让雷给劈了下，人反倒活下来了，气息也平稳了。”
沈青鱼闻言，眉心跳了下，总觉得这事透着怪异。
【尊上，事出反常必有妖。】
沈青鱼：“关我屁事。”
一大早青天白日打雷，天象还那个样子，要说没点什么才更奇怪。
那么大个雷劈下去，人不仅没死，还给劈活了，怎寻思都不正常。
沈青鱼抬头去看宣和帝，想看他是怎么想的，却发现他在看自己。
“呜呜，皇伯父，侄女要和离。”
老奸巨猾，可不能让他看穿她如今的秉性。

噗~
宣和帝一口茶喷出，不敢相信自己听到的，放下茶杯，抬手挖了挖自己的耳朵。
“你刚说什么来着？”
“我，要，和，离。”
宣和帝震惊了，忙从座位起身，走过来扯扯沈青的头发脸皮检查。
“疼疼疼。”
“疼就对了，不然朕还以为你被妖给害了，如今披着你的人皮与朕说话。”
“我有公主印加身，哪只妖不要命了，敢附我的身。”
“说的也是。”
宣和帝又坐了回去，拿起茶杯要喝水，不知想到什么又放了下来。
“你进宫来就是为了和离的？说说吧，为什么要和离，你不是喜欢周荣那小子，喜欢得可以连命都不要？”
“和离只是其中一件小事。”
沈青鱼夺了老王的手帕，在地板上蹭了蹭，然后盘腿一屁股坐了下去。
“自打昨日落水，我才发现原来我的脑子进了水，如今全都倒掉了，才发现周荣就是个垃圾。我堂堂大渊长公主，怎能娶一个垃圾为驸马，自然是要休掉的。”
宣和帝嘴角微抽，心想：我看你现在的样子，倒像脑子进了水。
刚还软弱可欺，泪眼汪汪，现在瞧着竟多了点痞气。
“你先解释一下，你与云珏是怎么一回事？”宣和帝道。
“您老不是有派人监视吗，就你知道的那样。”沈青鱼就这么大大咧咧说了出来。

Emperor Xuanhe's hand holding the pen shook, and his old face also twitched. The girl in front of him still looked so delicate and timid, but for some reason his back felt cold and the hairs all over his body stood up.
"What are you talking about? Get up quickly." Emperor Xuanhe said with twitching corners of his mouth.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu, Uncle Huang, I can't afford the fish." Shen Qingyu burst into tears, and in the blink of an eye his face was filled with tears, looking so pitiful.
Emperor Xuanhe felt distressed when he saw it, and the bad feeling became stronger. If this child is crying like this, he must be holding back some big trick.
"Old Wang, hurry up, help her up quickly."
Lao Wang hurriedly stepped forward to help, and Shen Qingyu got up immediately. He forgot that he had only just opened his pulse and his body was not much stronger than that of ordinary people. The pain of kneeling down just now made her burst into tears.
"Have you been bullied?" Emperor Xuanhe asked.
Shen Qingyu nodded hurriedly and briefly talked about what happened before and after yesterday's sunset, but did not mention Yun Jue's matter.
After hearing this, Emperor Xuanhe smiled and said, "I have already heard about this, but didn't you also suffer a loss? That girl from the Liu family had several ribs broken by you, and she has been rescued several times from yesterday to now."
Shen Qingyu differed: "I am a delicate and ordinary woman, how can I be so powerful?"
Lao Wang just heard the news and couldn't help but said: "Yes, the news just came that Miss Liu was struck by lightning today. But strangely enough, after being struck by lightning, the person survived and her breathing became stable."
When Shen Qingyu heard this, his eyebrows skipped a beat, and he always felt that this was something weird.
[Your Majesty, if something goes wrong, there must be a demon. 】
Shen Qingyu: "It's none of my business."
Early in the morning, the sky was blue and the sun was thundering. The weather was still like that. It would be even more strange to say that it was nothing.
When struck by such a huge lightning, not only did people not die, but they were also struck alive, which is not normal no matter how you think about it.
Shen Qingyu looked up at Emperor Xuanhe to see what he was thinking, but found that he was looking at her.
"Uuuuu, uncle Huang, my niece wants to make peace."
She is so cunning and cunning, but she cannot let him see through her current character.
Phew~
Emperor Xuanhe spurted out a sip of tea. He couldn't believe what he heard. He put down the tea cup and raised his hand to dig his ears.
"What did you just say?"
"I want peace and separation."
Emperor Xuanhe was shocked. He stood up from his seat and came over to pull Shen Qing's hair and face to check.
"It hurts."
"It's okay if it hurts, otherwise I would have thought you were harmed by a demon, and now you are talking to me in your human skin."
"I have the body of Princess Inca. No demon dares to possess me even if it doesn't cost its life."
"That's true."
Emperor Xuanhe sat back again, picked up the tea cup to drink water, and put it down again without knowing what he thought of.
"You came to the palace just to reconcile? Tell me, why do you want to reconcile? Don't you like that boy Zhou Rong so much that you even risk your life?"
"Separation is just one of the little things."
Shen Qingyu took Lao Wang's handkerchief, rubbed it on the floor, and then sat down cross-legged.
"Since I fell into the water yesterday, I realized that my brain was filled with water. Now that I have drained it all, I have discovered that Zhou Rong is trash. How can I, the majestic Princess Dayuan, marry a trash as my consort? Naturally I have to divorce her."
The corners of Emperor Xuanhe's lips twitched slightly, and he thought to himself: Looking at you now, you look like your brain is filled with water.
Just now he was weak and easy to bully, with tears in his eyes, but now he looks a little more naughty.
"Please explain first, what is going on between you and Yun Jue?" Emperor Xuanhe said.
"Didn't you always send someone to monitor you? As you know." Shen Qingyu said it so carelessly.
